secrets.name: PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Paystack secret key for live payments (sk_live_... or sk_test_...). Optional — app runs in demo mode without it. Set it here, never in git: GitHub push protection rejects commits containing sk_live keys.

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_PAYSTACK_KEY
secrets.description: Paystack public key for live checkout (pk_live_... or pk_test_...). Optional — app runs in demo mode without it. Set BOTH keys or neither: a mismatched pair mixes live + demo behaviour.

secrets.name: FOOTBALL_API_KEY
secrets.description: football-data.org API key for live fixture data. Optional — app falls back to seed data without it.

secrets.name: AFFILIATE_URL_TEMPLATE
secrets.description: Template for tracked affiliate links in odds comparison. Optional.

secrets.name: AUTH_SECRET
secrets.description: Signs the session cookie (HS256). Optional — a dev secret is used if unset.
